mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports (TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TARGET_USER_ID, REASON_DETAIL, REPORTER_ID) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetUserId}, #{reasonDetail}, #{reporterId})
mapper.select: SELECT r.REPORT_ID, r.TARGET_TYPE, r.TARGET_ID, r.TARGET_USER_ID, r.REASON_DETAIL, r.STATUS, r.RESULT, r.PROCESSED_BY, r.PROCESSED_AT, r.REPORTER_ID, r.CREATED_AT, u.NICKNAME AS reporterNickname, tu.NICKNAME AS targetUserNickname, p.TITLE AS postTitle, p.DELETED_AT AS postDeletedAt, p.DELETED_BY_TYPE AS postDeletedByType, cm.CONTENT AS commentContent, cm.DELETED_AT AS commentDeletedAt, cm.DELETED_BY_TYPE AS commentDeletedByType FROM reports r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.USER_ID = r.REPORTER_ID LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.USER_ID = r.TARGET_USER_ID LEFT JOIN posts p ON r.TARGET_TYPE = 'POST' AND p.POST_ID = r.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN comments cm ON r.TARGET_TYPE = 'COMMENT' AND cm.COMMENT_ID = r.TARGET_ID ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT REPORT_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TARGET_USER_ID, REASON_DETAIL, STATUS, RESULT, PROCESSED_BY, PROCESSED_AT, REPORTER_ID, CREATED_AT FROM reports WHERE REPORT_ID = #{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET STATUS = 'DONE', RESULT = #{result}, PROCESSED_BY = #{processedBy}, PROCESSED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE REPORT_ID = #{reportId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
